title: AI数据中心散热压力显现 城市热岛效应引关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We do not want a data center in this county.
segments.zh: 我们不希望本县建数据中心。

segments.en: Pushback over the enormous use of resources required by data centers can't be ignored.
segments.zh: 数据中心资源消耗巨大，引发的反对不容忽视。

segments.en: And on top of the widely held concerns, lurks another factor, literally heating things up.
segments.zh: 除了普遍担忧，还有一个因素在推高温度。

segments.en: What many people don't know is that the data centers are releasing massive amounts of heat into the atmosphere, raising local air temperatures in nearby neighborhoods.
segments.zh: 许多人不知道，数据中心正释放大量热量，推高附近社区的气温。

segments.en: What you're seeing in this video is thermal infrared imagery that we took from a Cyrus I data center in Arizona.
segments.zh: 这段视频是我们在亚利桑那州一个Cyrus I数据中心拍摄的热红外影像。

segments.en: It's basically showing just how hot these rooftops can get.
segments.zh: 它基本展示了这些屋顶能有多热。

segments.en: The dark purple represents the lowest temperatures detected.
segments.zh: 深紫色代表检测到的最低温度。

segments.en: The brightest yellows and whites represent the hottest temperatures.
segments.zh: 最亮的黄色和白色代表最高温度。

segments.en: Bloomberg captured this footage to visualize hotspots on this data center, which was one of four studied by Arizona State University researchers.
segments.zh: 彭博社拍摄这段影像，以可视化该数据中心的热点，它是亚利桑那州立大学研究人员研究的四个数据中心之一。

segments.en: For the Cyrus I data center, they found that temperatures were increasing up to four degrees Fahrenheit downwind.
segments.zh: 对于Cyrus I数据中心，他们发现下风向温度升高了高达4华氏度。

segments.en: They also found that heat plumes were extending up to a third of a mile from facility perimeters.
segments.zh: 他们还发现，热羽流从设施边界向外延伸可达三分之一英里。

segments.en: Data centers have been around for decades.
segments.zh: 数据中心已经存在了几十年。
